selected_projects.name: Web Data Ingestion & Document Automation Pipeline
selected_projects.description: Built an end-to-end, provider-agnostic AI pipeline that ingests web data at scale, transforms it through structured LLM processing and generates formatted documents automatically.
highlights: Orchestrated a multi-stage LLM workflow spanning web scraping, structured data extraction and content generation, with schema-validated JSON at each stage.
Designed a config-driven provider abstraction so LLM vendor and model can be swapped without code changes, avoiding vendor lock-in.
Automated the pipeline with GitHub Actions triggered by input files, persisting data and generated documents in Supabase (Postgres and object storage).
Engineered JSON-schema-constrained LLM outputs feeding a Python document generator that produces formatted DOCX files.
